text: Heb. blinded. , Or, fetters. , Heb. house of the wards.
Or, chiefe Marshall. Heb. chiefe of the executioners or slaughtermen. And so vers.14. &c. , Heb. stood before.
Or, instruments to remooue the ashes. , Or, basons.
Heb. saw the face of the king. , Or, scribe of the captaine of the hoste.
Heb. the matter of the day in his day.
